name: SWIM4SWIM
source:
The 2026 USA Swimming Futures Championships are scheduled to take place from July 29 to August 1, 2026.

On a sunny fourteenth of July in Lake Ontario, I keep my promise. 

[From [url=https://rombuffer.itch.io/swim4swim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2026年美國游泳協會未來之星錦標賽定於2026年7月29日至8月1日舉行。

7月14日，陽光明媚，我在安大略湖中兌現了諾言。
